rituals.name: Kurmai

items.item: gifts from the bride's family to the groom

rituals.significance: The engagement: after an Ardas (prayer), the bride's family blesses the groom and the families commit to the marriage.

rituals.name: Chunni Chadana
rituals.significance: The groom's family places a chunni over the bride's head, welcoming her into their family.

rituals.name: Maiyan and Vatna

items.item: Vatna paste (turmeric, gram flour, mustard oil)

rituals.significance: Relatives apply a turmeric paste to cleanse and brighten the bride and groom before the wedding.

rituals.name: Jaggo
participants: led by the maternal aunt (maami) carrying the jaggo

items.item: Decorated brass or clay pot (jaggo) with oil lamps

rituals.significance: Relatives dance and sing through the night with a lamp-lit pot, announcing the wedding to the neighbourhood.

rituals.name: Choora

items.item: Choora (set of red and ivory bangles)
bowl of milk and rose petals
kaleere (gold or silver ornaments tied to the bangles)

rituals.significance: The bride's maternal uncle gives her the choora bangles; relatives tie on kaleere as blessings.

rituals.name: Sehrabandi and Baraat

items.item: Sehra (veil of flowers or pearls) tied over the turban

rituals.significance: The groom's turban is adorned with a sehra, and the wedding party sets off for the bride's side.

rituals.name: Milni
participants: Male relatives of both families in matching pairs (fathers, uncles, brothers)
rituals.significance: Relatives of the same relationship from each family embrace and exchange garlands, joining the two families.

rituals.name: Anand Karaj

items.item: Palla (long scarf worn by the groom)

rituals.significance: The couple walk around the Guru Granth Sahib four times as the four Laavan are sung, each round a stage of married life.

rituals.name: Laavan
participants: family members who stand around the path

items.item: cleared walkway around the Guru Granth Sahib

rituals.significance: Four hymns composed by Guru Ram Das are sung; the couple, holding the palla, circle the scripture once per hymn.

rituals.name: Ardas and Karah Prashad
rituals.significance: A closing prayer and a reading (Hukamnama) bless the couple, and everyone receives Karah Prashad.

rituals.name: Doli

items.item: Puffed rice or grain to throw over the shoulder

rituals.significance: The bride's emotional farewell; she throws grain behind her, wishing prosperity for her parents' home.

rituals.name: Paani Vaarna

items.item: mustard oil to pour at the threshold

rituals.significance: The groom's mother circles water over the couple's heads and sips it, welcoming the bride home.
